name: One list, every room
bet: One list of every room, always in the same order, each row saying whether the room is free and until when, answers her question the way the wall chart does: by where she looks, not by anything she does.
cost: Free rooms are not pulled out for her: she reads down the rows to find them, and with twelve rooms a free one can sit at the bottom.
absent: A calendar, or any view of later in the day
A filter or a sort control
A separate count of free rooms
hardest: When nothing is free, every row still says when its room frees up and the soonest is marked; the list never empties and never says "no results".

screens.title: Today, glanced at between calls
screens.note: Open all day on the desk monitor; nothing on it moves when the 30-second refresh lands.

items.text: Every room, in the order of the wall chart
items.note: A long room name is cut before its status is; the status is never shortened.
